notes: Fresh review of the November 22 clarity revision, not a reuse of the previous PASS. Accuracy PASS: the Fed meeting, minutes release, IPO, and two trading days are distinguished; all five price changes were independently recalculated against their stated starting prices. The October minutes, decision statement, release notice, September projections, FRED DGS10, BEA September PCE release, BLS CPI and PPI archives, Forbes first-day article, and Motley Fool dated 4:00 p.m. quote were checked. Forbes and BLS required browser retrieval after HTTP 403 responses. Flow PASS: the opening explains why the Fed record and Anthropic debut are compared without implying causation, defines a close, and introduces the complete price sequence before the detailed analysis. Consistency PASS: cards, chronological table, comparison table, chart labels, conclusion, and methodology distinguish IPO price, first public trade, day-one close, and day-two close. Later-published PCE is explicitly separate from the estimate available at the meeting. Visual gate PASS: both figures were screenshot-reviewed at desktop and 400px; the existing mobile horizontal-scroll design was checked at both ends, with visible swipe guidance added. All chart labels are reachable, and there is no page-wide overflow. Listing card PASS: one description, expected tags, date, author, and loaded yield image. SEO PASS: unchanged pagetitle is 51 characters and description is 158 characters; six preferred tags, real image, and no subtitle. No MANUAL, placeholder, or TODO markers were found in the QMD or stats script. Snapshot verification, pipeline, final post lint, repository audit, rendered inline values, internal timeline link, and canonical freeze passed. Original market-price transcriptions still have no retrieval timestamp or archived article copies; the post says so. Revised QMD and freeze are saved on the clarity branch. No commit, merge, push, or publication was performed; human approval is the next step.
score_notes: The event sequence and price baselines are now explicit across prose, tables, cards, and figures. Remaining limitations are a dense Fed discussion, horizontal scrolling on phones, and market-report provenance without archived source copies.
release_readiness: Review gates PASS. Awaiting human approval; publication gate and live deployment are not performed.
